description: React component for a code editor wrapper using CodeMirror, supporting syntax highlighting, line highlighting, error display, and link handling.

methods.name: onCodeMirrorClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the CodeMirror component, opening links in new tabs.

methods.name: defineCustomMode
methods.description: Defines a custom CodeMirror mode for linkified text.

methods.name: mimeTypeToMode
methods.description: Converts MIME types to CodeMirror modes.

methods.name: highlighterToMode
methods.description: Converts highlighter types to CodeMirror modes.
